bagPolicy.summary: Large or oversized bags, backpacks and duffel bags are not allowed inside for shows and events. Leave them in your vehicle, or ask security staff about special accommodations.

parking.summary: Spirit asks guests not to park in front of residences on Hatfield Street or on 50th Street. It hasn't published other public parking details, so check your event page or contact the venue.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Spirit. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Spirit's restaurant serves pizzas, salads and sides, with plenty of vegan and vegetarian options. Both cash and credit cards are accepted.

accessibility.summary: Spirit's event rental page lists access to an ADA-compliant restroom for the Lodge, its lower-level room. It hasn't published other accessibility details, so contact the venue before you go.

reEntry.summary: Spirit hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Age limits vary by event. Children are welcome until 9pm, or until the start of any earlier event with age restrictions. Spirit hasn't published box office or will call details, so check your event page.

gates.summary: Spirit hasn't published entrance and door time details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
